property_summary: When owner is 0x1, a call to owned() followed by transferOwnership from 0x1 sets owner to 0x1 (reference) or to msg.sender (bug); but if msg.sender is different from the intended new owner, the bug causes a change that the reference does not.
change_summary: In transferOwnership, change the assignment to 'owner = _newOwner' so that it always sets owner to the caller (msg.sender) regardless of argument, which can alter ownership on legitimate calls.
